requirements.text: We are seeking a versatile and independent C\+\+ Software Engineer to join the AI Infrastructure Silicon Validation team. Rather than designing chips, this role focuses on writing robust software to test, validate, and stress\-test AI infrastructure platforms. You will use your strong Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) foundation to build validation applications, integrate with hardware vendor SDKs (including NVIDIA CUDA), and independently deliver reliable testing code.
* Strong C\+\+ \& OOP: Solid proficiency in core C\+\+ (including modern standards like C\+\+14/C\+\+17\) with a deep understanding of classes, inheritance, polymorphism, and memory management.
* SDK \& API Integration: Successfully integrate and utilize third\-party SDKs and low\-level APIs, specifically including CUDA, to interact with compute hardware.
* Linux Environment: Comfortable developing, compiling (e.g., CMake/Make), and running applications in a standard Linux environment.
* Independent Execution: Take ownership of assigned validation features from technical requirements through to delivery, debugging, and documentation with minimal supervision.
* Experience writing unit tests or automated validation suites.
* Basic familiarity with multi\-threaded programming or concurrent execution concepts.
* Familiarity with Python for basic scripting or test automation wrappers
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience working in complex (preferably) HW\-SW projects with tight schedules
